lesson: Only take positions on news with an importance score of 4 or higher that directly impacts core defense programs or major contract wins, avoiding peripheral commercial PR.
Do not buy intraday dips on large-cap defense contractors without confirmed volume and price stabilization above intraday VWAP.
Require a minimum conviction of 4 and verify price is above VWAP before entering, especially in risk‑off markets
Avoid entering long positions immediately after earnings if the stock trades below VWAP or shows overbought RSI
Implement a partial‑scale‑out (e.g., 50% at 1R) to lock in gains and reduce exposure to late‑day reversals
Do not enter momentum longs in the first 15 minutes of the open if the stock's 5-minute RSI is above 75, as opening whipsaws frequently hit stops.
Do not re-enter a ticker more than twice in a single session to avoid churn, wash-trade rejections, and depleting the daily trade limit.
Do not open new long positions on stocks already up >5% intraday unless backed by high relative volume and a tight 15-minute consolidation base.
Cap total entries on any single ticker to a maximum of two trades per session to prevent churn and over-trading losses during market chop.
Only take news‑catalyst longs when price is above VWAP and relative volume >1.5x average
Limit re‑entries on the same ticker to one per day to avoid churn
Implement a 50% partial‑scale‑out at 1R to lock in gains early
